ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:name: dma_ctrl
ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:description: Source, destination, length, and control registers for the iDMA data-mover engine.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DECOUPLE_AW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write-address decoupling. 0: the write address of each burst is held until the first read data beat of the matching read burst returns. 1: write addresses are issued without waiting for read data.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DECOUPLE_RW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read/write decoupling. 0: read and write bursts are formed in lockstep, one write burst per read burst. 1: read and write bursts are formed and issued independently; this mode can deadlock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SRC_REDUCE_LEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Source burst-length reduction. 1: read bursts are limited by SRC_MAX_LLEN. 0: a read burst is at most 256 beats and does not cross a 2 KiB-aligned boundary.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DST_REDUCE_LEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Destination burst-length reduction. 1: write bursts are limited by DST_MAX_LLEN. 0: a write burst is at most 256 beats and does not cross a 2 KiB-aligned boundary.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SRC_MAX_LLEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Base-2 logarithm of the maximum read burst length in 64-bit beats, applied when SRC_REDUCE_LEN is 1. A read burst does not cross a boundary aligned to 2^(SRC_MAX_LLEN+3) bytes; 0 gives single-beat bursts. Ignored when SRC_REDUCE_LEN is 0.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DST_MAX_LLEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Base-2 logarithm of the maximum write burst length in 64-bit beats, applied when DST_REDUCE_LEN is 1. A write burst does not cross a boundary aligned to 2^(DST_MAX_LLEN+3) bytes; 0 gives single-beat bursts. Ignored when DST_REDUCE_LEN is 0.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ENABLED_ND
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Repetition enable. 1: the copy is performed NUM_REPETITIONS times, with SRC_STRIDE and DST_STRIDE added to the addresses between rows; set it for every transfer, including a linear copy with NUM_REPETITIONS = 1. 0: the repetition count is forced to zero, so the command completes with an error response, moves no data, and still retires its transfer ID.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUSY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Status for the active stream: bits [7:0] each indicate readiness to accept another command, bit 8 indicates midend activity, and bit 9 is zero. These bits do not report backend busy or prove transfer completion; use DONE for completed transfer IDs. Unused streams read zero.
